audience: sales teams who manage contacts, companies and deals in Freshsales

useCases.title: Find a contact, company or deal
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts, companies or deals by name or email, or looks up an exact value such as an email address. It can open a contact with its notes, tasks and deals.

useCases.title: Review deals in a saved view
useCases.text: The AI lists the deals of a saved view such as Open Deals with amount, expected close and probability, and opens one with its stage, owner and contacts.

useCases.title: Check overdue tasks and upcoming appointments
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks that are overdue, due today or open, and upcoming appointments with time and location, so you see what to do next.

useCases.title: Add or update a contact, or add a company
useCases.text: The AI searches first to avoid duplicates, then creates a contact or a company, or changes fields of an existing contact.

useCases.title: Create or update a deal
useCases.text: The AI creates a deal with name, amount and company, or changes a deal's stage, amount or expected close date, after it looks up pipelines and stages.

useCases.title: Add notes and appointments, or create or complete tasks
useCases.text: The AI adds a note to a contact, company or deal, creates a task with a due date, marks a task done, or creates an appointment with attendees.
